title: Copy the demo into the product frontend, with a build
request: Build the real product with exactly the demo's UI, UX and frontend, and make it work for real with a backend; change nothing in the UI unless the owner asks.
spec: dclab_rnd/agentic/web/src/ (shell, styles, core, one view file per page) and web/build.py writing separate files into dclab_rnd/agentic/static/app/. Done when the build's --check says the frontend is up to date and tests/test_web_build.py passes.
plan: Explore the backend, the current web UI and the demo frontend in parallel to see what the product can reuse.
Copy docs/product-demo/src into dclab_rnd/agentic/web/src without changing its look.
Write build.py: assemble index.html, app.css and one JavaScript file per view and data file into static/app, nothing inlined.
Add --check (exit 1 when static/app is stale or has extra files), a make web target, and the check inside make rd-check.
Serve it on a test server with a temporary data folder and compare screenshots with demo v1.

decisions.decision: The build writes separate files instead of one self-contained page.
decisions.why: The server's Content-Security-Policy allows no inline scripts or styles, so a single inlined page like the demo's would be blocked.

decisions.decision: static/app is generated and checked for freshness in rd-check.
decisions.why: A hand edit to generated output would silently drift from the sources.

decisions.decision: A test server with a temporary DCLAB_AGENT_HOME, never the owner's running notebook.
decisions.why: The owner's make notebook on port 8765 holds real projects that a check must not touch.

change: New dclab_rnd/agentic/web/src (copied from the frozen demo) and web/build.py writing static/app; make web; the build check in rd-check; tests/test_web_build.py (build current, nothing the CSP would block, inline style caught, root serves the product).

measurements.name: look parity with demo v1
measurements.gate: Every page served by the real server under the strict CSP renders the same as demo v1, with no console error.
measurements.result: Screenshots matched demo v1 and five pages checked first had no console or CSP error; later all 19 pages were checked.
measurements.against_gate: The gate asks for every page. The first check covered five pages, with screenshots matching demo v1 and no console or CSP error; only the later check of all 19 pages covers the gate as written.
limits: Screenshots were compared by eye, not pixel by pixel, so a small shift in spacing could pass.
The pages still showed demo sample data: the check says the look survived the copy, not that any page works against the API.
It was checked at a desktop width only; a phone-width top-bar problem was fixed in the product later.

outcome: Done: the demo's exact UI is served by the real server from built files; make web rebuilds and rd-check fails when static/app is stale. Pages still showed sample data and were wired to the API phase by phase.
lessons: When a design must not change, copy it and add a build step around it rather than rewriting it; the check that the output is current keeps the copy honest.
risks: The demo's build inlines every script and style into one page; under the server's CSP, which allows no inline code, a straight copy would render blank.
A hand edit to the generated static/app drifts from web/src without anyone noticing.
Checking against the owner's running notebook on port 8765 could touch real projects.
Pages still carry the demo's sample numbers after the copy and can be mistaken for real results.
A copy step can change the look slightly (fonts, spacing) in a way only a side-by-side screenshot shows.
